desc:
Welcome to the Baddie vs. Chibi Tower!

Pick a team and overcome obstacles to discover outfits for your favorite character.

Will you choose a baddie tee or a chibi outfit?
Baddie... or chibi?

Each character grants you a new accessory, hat, and outfit as you parkour your way up the tower.

👕 Get dressed up while tackling crazy levels!
🔥 Unlock unique outfits for your favorite character from your chosen team.
😂 Play with friends and compare your choices!

🏆 Reach the top and show off your favorite outfit.

👍 Like the game and join the group to get exclusive rewards.

Can you survive the tower...?
